verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of Jira's role or permission controls for who can view or edit work. Nearby items do not count: 'Global and project-level configuration' is generic configuration, SAML/SSO covers authentication rather than authorization, and the audit trail is a separate control. The only mention of 'permission schemes' comes from a community user asking which competitors offer such features. That is a question, not affirmative evidence of the capability.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can assign granular permissions and roles to control who can view or edit work
